author: coder-sonnet
message: Implemented GOV-001 dashboard: tools/roadmap-dashboard/server.mjs (Node builtins only, zero deps, listens 127.0.0.1 only) + tools/roadmap-dashboard/index.html (Kanban UI, 4 columns, auto-refresh 4s, execute + log + comments panels). roadmap.md parsed read-only (opened with flag 'r', cached by mtime, never written). Runtime ledger roadmap-status.md uses append-only fenced JSON blocks + atomic temp-file+rename writes. Comments use comments/<TICKET>.jsonl one-JSON-per-line with {timestamp, author, type, message}. Logs at logs/<ticket>-<timestamp>.log, viewable via /api/log with ticket-id + path-traversal validation. Claude runner spawns exact command: claude --model <id> -p <prompt> --output-format stream-json --verbose via spawn() with argument arrays (no shell:true, no string interpolation). Model allowlist enforced: claude-fable-5, claude-opus-4-8, claude-sonnet-5. Codex is a fully separate adapter reading tools/roadmap-dashboard/codex.config.json (git-ignored/local, not committed); unconfigured Codex returns state=blocked with a clear message and is never passed to claude --model. Execute validation chain: ticket-id regex ^[A-Z]+-\d{3}$, ticket exists in roadmap.md, runner+model allowlisted, ticket state pending/blocked/failed (not already completed/in_progress), no active run for ticket (race-safe via synchronous in-memory reservation before any await), all dependencies completed per ledger (not roadmap text) -- returns HTTP 412 with incompleteDependencies list on failure. One active run per ticket enforced both via ledger fold and an in-memory activeRuns Map reserved synchronously to close a race window found and fixed during verification (rapid concurrent POSTs to the same ticket could both pass the pre-await active-run check before either write landed). VERIFICATION RESULTS: node --check tools/roadmap-dashboard/server.mjs -> pass. GET /api/tickets -> 23 tickets returned (roadmap.md contains 23 level-2 ticket headings: DIS-001..003, GOV-001, INF-001..003, APP-001..014, INT-001..002 -- confirmed via grep count; the ticket text's '21 roadmap tickets' verification note does not match the actual roadmap.md content, flagged as a deviation, not a bug). shasum roadmap.md before and after a full test session (multiple ticket lookups, execute attempts, comment writes, concurrent execute race test) was identical both times: 7e07511256e5dfb6015f3788a6f93b1d2474b3e8 -- confirms roadmap.md is never mutated. Execute on INF-001 (dependency GOV-001 not completed in ledger) -> HTTP 412 JSON {ok:false, error, incompleteDependencies:['GOV-001']}. Execute with runner=codex and no codex.config.json present -> HTTP 200 {ok:true, state:'blocked', message: clear instructions to create tools/roadmap-dashboard/codex.config.json}. Path traversal attempts on /api/log and /api/comments (../ segments) -> HTTP 400 rejected. Invalid ticket id formats and nonexistent tickets -> HTTP 400/404 respectively. Model/runner allowlist violations -> HTTP 400 with allowlist echoed. Server killed cleanly after tests (SIGTERM/SIGINT handlers registered). Test-only ledger/logs/comments entries created during verification were reset before this completion entry so the ledger's first real entry is this GOV-001 completion record.
